PluginData.Description:
Works with the Korean Localization Pack on the Steam Workshop (1843839106) to add Korean language support to the game.
Pulsar subscribes to the required pack when you enable this plugin and apply the changes.
* Select Korean language in the game settings!
* Loads Korean fonts from a plugin cache and enables Korean input. Korean input also works regardless of the UI language.
* Automatically adds Korean fonts to useful mods such as TextHudAPI, RichHudMaster, and Build Info.
Legacy font-only mods 2409196107 and 2940288034, also maintained by Arstraea, are skipped client-side when replacement fonts are ready. Subscriptions and saved world mod lists remain unchanged.
For questions, contact Arstraea through any of the following: - Korean Localization Pack on the Steam Workshop - Naver Cafe (cafe.naver.com/spaceengineersforum) - Ruliweb: Arstraea (member ID 5042027)
